categories.summary: The discussion centered on community concerns about ElizaOS project communication and development status. Key technical points: Shaw is actively developing on GitHub, with Eliza v3 already released and available by cloning the main repository. The Eliza framework is being used by many builders for further projects. Shaw recently posted about the Eliza app on X/Twitter. Development of Milady and Eliza v3 app continues but without firm release dates. A legal settlement was reached with the lawsuit dismissed with prejudice on 7/8/2026, with the court retaining 30-day jurisdiction to enforce the settlement. The main tension arose from paolin_62616 expressing frustration about lack of updates on official channels (X, Discord, Farcaster all described as 'dead' since late May), while j_choy defended the team's GitHub activity. paolin_62616 suggested a tokenomics model requiring users to buy and lock tokens to access plugins/services, which would prevent sell-offs and increase value. Shaw mentioned seeking funding/investors for expansion. om1d_sa confirmed v3 has been released and is receiving updates, and requested odlitime be brought back to the team. The discussion highlighted a communication gap between active development work and community engagement.

faqs.question: Is anyone looking for a developer?

helpInteractions.context: Confusion about Eliza v3 release status and availability
helpInteractions.resolution: Clarified that v3 was released long ago and is available by cloning the main repository, with ongoing updates

actionItems.description: Implement tokenomics model requiring users to buy and lock tokens to access plugins/services
Improve automatic server updates for community channels
Provide regular updates on official communication channels (X, Discord, Farcaster)
Complete and release Eliza v3 app with defined release date
